items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Bach K and Yellow Nunez and Shields and different ones at different times.

ctx.x: One clarinetist, Bach K, did you ever know him?

Bach K, yes. I remember him. I think he played with the band quite a bit. He played for Jack Lane. Bach K used to have time, play job dates with us. Maybe when Gussie Mule was sick or couldn't get off or something happened. Bach K and Yellow Nunez and Shields and different ones at different times. The same as Harry Shields, who play with different combinations around here now. And you'd see him on television with, what's this little short caller's name again? Shockey. Shockey. And he'd play around with different…
Do you remember a fellow named Dave Perkins? I think he played trombone. Dave Perkins, yes.
